title: Flutter: Rust engine FFI for offline/local play
description: Compile Rust engine to shared library (.so/.dylib/.dll) via cargo. Use dart:ffi + ffigen to call engine functions from Dart. Wrap GameSession, apply_action, legal_moves, to_wire_state. Enables offline play against AI agents, local hot-seat multiplayer, and move validation without server round-trip. Flutter isolate for engine calls (no UI jank).
